winds.scope: Recorded Chinese wind instruments for redistribution inside the sight-reading app
winds.decision: Prepare the verified CC0 C-dizi bank for Bangdi/Qudi with an honest shared-source caption. Preserve accepted soprano Sheng. No suitable redistributable sustained multisample bank was verified for lower Sheng, Xindi, Suona or Guan during this research.

readyBank.author: Hypnotriod
readyBank.instrument: One C dizi, a Chinese membrane bamboo flute
readyBank.downloadQuality: Public HQ MP3 previews embedded in the original Freesound pages. Original WAV download requires login; the production WAVs are decoded from lossy previews.
qualityChecks: Every original page explicitly links CC0; the full raw page, download URL and source hash are retained in the temporary source folder.
The numeric MIDI in each original filename matches measured waveform fundamental; the written note/octave suffix is one octave too high in scientific pitch notation.
The pack contains 25 files: 15 diatonic anchors and 10 creator-pitched semitone copies. The prepared bank keeps only the 15 anchors.
Median pitch centers were measured in four sustained windows, corrected by bandlimited resampling and verified after 16-bit quantization.
All output WAVs decode with finite samples, no clipping and more than seven seconds of recorded audio.
Five-millisecond onset and thirty-millisecond final fades avoid file-edge clicks; initial-second level is balanced with peak headroom.
limitations: These are shared C-dizi recordings, not separate recordings of each Bangdi/Qudi size or key.
Xindi is membrane-free; this membrane dizi must not be labeled as an authentic Xindi recording.
Visible Bangdi G reaches E7, nine semitones above the highest recorded G6; hidden Bangdi C reaches A7, fourteen semitones above it. Upper-range formant shifts remain possible.
Qudi C reaches A6, only two semitones above the top anchor.
No sustain loop is created. Extremely long notes can outlast the sample; upward repitching also shortens available sustain.

otherCandidates.author: S099001
otherCandidates.material: Own recording of a 36-reed soprano Sheng chromatic scale; 17-second Vorbis file
otherCandidates.reason: The scale provides only short successive tones, generally a few tenths of a second. It is not a sustained multisample bank and does not represent tenor or bass Sheng. Automatic fundamental estimates have harmonic/octave ambiguities, so no reliable complete pitch map is asserted. Preserve the user's accepted existing soprano Sheng timbre.

otherCandidates.author: Francesc Fort / NENU Folklorical Orchestra
otherCandidates.reason: Short ornamental phrases with pitch scoops; detected stable-note fragments are under one second and often detuned by tens of cents. No isolated long notes or lower keyed-Suona variants. Not suitable for an unlooped sustained-note bank.

otherCandidates.material: 3.692-second suona.wav; page says extracted from A Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix
otherCandidates.reason: Short recital crop rather than an isolated sustained sample; original performance provenance is not identified sufficiently for a strong source chain.

winds.integrationBoundary: Only new public/samples/dizi-recorded files and scripts/prepare-dizi-samples.py were prepared by this agent. Shared application files, manifest, sample credits and tests belong to the parent agent.
winds.remainingPracticalRoute: Obtain direct redistribution permission or commission isolated sustained chromatic/multisample recordings for Xindi, lower Sheng, Suona variants and Guan variants. No email, external message or purchase was made.

selected.author: Pufermufin
selected.evidence: Author describes recording a Chinese Guzheng with Blue Spark and Bluebird microphones through a Scarlett 6i6. Source page explicitly licenses the sound CC0 and exposes the public HQ MP3 share URL. The original WAV requires Freesound login. Isolated normal plucks from the public preview are used, not synthetic or GarageBand output.

rejectedOrUnresolved.reason: The code repository has an MIT software license and links a separate 530 MB recording archive. It does not explicitly confirm that the MIT grant covers the external performance recordings. Do not infer audio-redistribution permission from the software license.
Dataset is explicitly CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, unsuitable for modified samples distributed in a paid application.
An authentic isolated A4 exists, but the source license is CC BY-NC 4.0.
11-second demonstration contains changing notes, resonating multiple strings and short attacks. No clean multisample range; do not replace the existing Pipa with this poorer source.

rejectedOrUnresolved.author: Francesc Fort / NENU Folklorical Orchestra
rejectedOrUnresolved.reason: 32-second performance has short notes, overlapping/sympathetic strings and background sound. Pitch analysis varies within candidate decays. A clean full-range bank could not be derived without inventing sustained notes or substantial artifacts.
Tagged with Ruan instruments but source is opera singing accompanied by an orchestra, not isolated Ruan.

Description explicitly says iPad GarageBand output; uploader's CC0 does not establish permission to redistribute underlying Apple instrument samples as a playable sample bank. Also not a fresh acoustic recording.
Commercial music-production sample pack. No verified raw-sample redistribution grant for an instrument app.

rejectedOrUnresolved.status: No acceptable free isolated sample source found in this pass
rejectedOrUnresolved.reason: Primary-source searches covered Freesound, Wikimedia Commons, Chinese datasets, GitHub, BISA and commercial vendor leads. No files are relabeled from related instruments.

accepted.coverage: Revision 2: 24 recorded chromatic roots D4-C#6; one selected microphone channel per root. D6 is repitched from C#6 by one semitone; original noisy D6 excluded.
accepted.caveat: Original microphones can be out of phase: do not downmix L+R. Revision 2 selects one original channel, avoiding cancellation and the rough D6 source. Natural bow texture remains; this is not a professional expressive performance library.

otherSourcesReviewed.license: CC BY, version unspecified on source collection page
otherSourcesReviewed.result: Existing regular vibrato A4/E5 confirmed. Collection also has accented notes D4, F4, Ab4, A4, C5, Eb5, Gb5, A5, about 1 second each. These do not add a consistent full range sustain set. Existing assets retained for rollback.

bowed.searchCoverage: Primary Berklee BISA, Freesound exact instrument searches, SFZ Instruments GitHub catalog, CC0/Creative Commons queries, Chinese-language instrument/sample queries, CCOM-HuQin and CCMUSIC datasets, professional developer sites. Unlicensed hardware ROM extractions, mixed concert excerpts, photographs marked CC0 and unrelated instruments were excluded. This is a documented search result, not proof that no sample exists anywhere.

playbackLimits.Pipa: Local preview uses the user-supplied Pianobook bank, which is not bundled for redistribution. Production retains the older two recital extracts. No suitable replacement verified this search.
playbackLimits.Voice: One recorded sung-vowel anchor remains; not a full-range choir or solfege library.
playbackLimits.Western: All 17 already have recorded banks. New solo Viola/Cello replace sections; new Bassoon/Horn/Trombone anchors reduce sparse gaps. Other banks retained.
playbackLimits.Dizi: Bangdi/Qudi share one C-dizi bank; Xindi keeps clearly named western flute substitute. Not separate recordings of every size/key.
playbackLimits.Guzheng: 15 recorded roots D2-D5; notes above D5 are shifted from the nearest root.
playbackLimits.ExpressivePlayback: Recorded attacks and timbre, with repitching where needed. Articulated legato, velocity layers and round-robin variations are not yet sampled.
